properties.name: pos.accounting.default-mappings.enabled
properties.description: Enable default GL mapping fallback when explicit posting rules are missing.

properties.name: pos.accounting.default-mappings.allow-global-defaults
properties.description: Allow fallback to organization-agnostic default mappings.

properties.name: pos.accounting.default-mappings.require-amount-field
properties.description: Require payload.amount when creating journal entries from default mappings.

properties.name: pos.accounting.credit-memo.revenue-account-id
properties.description: GL account used for credit memo revenue reversal entries.

properties.name: pos.accounting.credit-memo.tax-payable-account-id
properties.description: GL account used for credit memo tax payable reversal entries.

properties.name: pos.accounting.credit-memo.ar-account-id
properties.description: GL account used for credit memo accounts receivable reversal entries.

properties.name: pos.accounting.kafka.enabled
properties.description: Enable accounting Kafka consumers for payment-cleared events.

properties.name: pos.accounting.kafka.payments-topic
properties.description: Kafka topic containing payment-cleared events.

properties.name: pos.accounting.kafka.consumer-group
properties.description: Kafka consumer group for accounting payment event consumers.

properties.name: pos.invoice.service.url
properties.description: Base URL for the pos-invoice service.

properties.name: pos.customer.service.url
properties.description: Base URL for the pos-customer service.

properties.name: pos.workorder.service.url
properties.description: Base URL for the pos-workorder service.

properties.name: pos.restclient.connect.timeout
properties.description: RestClient connect timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: pos.restclient.read.timeout
properties.description: RestClient read timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: payment.gateway.provider
properties.description: Payment gateway provider selector for accounting payment flows.

properties.name: stripe.api-key
properties.description: Stripe API key used for payment gateway calls.

properties.name: stripe.connect-account
properties.description: Optional Stripe Connect account id for destination charges.

properties.name: stripe.idempotency-window-hours
properties.description: Number of hours to retain Stripe idempotency keys.

properties.name: pos.events.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the pos-events/event-receiver API.

properties.name: pos.events.api-secret
properties.description: Shared secret used to authenticate event type registration requests.

properties.name: pos.security.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for permission registration against pos-security-service.

properties.name: pos.security.permission-registration.enabled
properties.description: Enable startup permission registration with pos-security-service.
